completed_population.policy: Every comparison retains all completed game identities. Wins, losses, pushes and unresolved must sum to 163. Full-population champion status requires zero unresolved games.

correction.selection: All 96 saved policies rescored on the same 163 completed games. Spread selection changed; total selection retained.
correction.custody: Historical records are reconstructed and 2026-exposed. Current ordinary sides are reselected using saved N202 inputs and prices. They are not original N202 issues.

notes: Selected probabilities are model estimates, not achieved accuracy.
The ordinary spread and totals model uses 2026 for selection. Its historical results are reconstructed and previously exposed.
Earlier-week replay selects from prior completed weeks only; research design was developed after inspecting this season.
Source refresh, model selection, original issue and website publication have separate clocks.
Ordinary side probabilities condition on no push. Circa displays unconditional cover and push probabilities.
This snapshot does not refresh prices, injury reports or models when opened.
